request: Discover actual Astera v8 separately registered product runtime and availability of its existing OpenAI-compatible LLM adapter as potential second AI Core consumer; no inference, no code change, no secret output.

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
msg="AI_CORE_SECOND_CONSUMER_ASTERA_DISCOVERY"
src=/home/admin1/projects/astera_v8
if test -d "$src/.git"; then
 v=$(git -C "$src" rev-parse HEAD)
 msg="$msg SOURCE_HEAD=$v"
else msg="$msg SOURCE_HEAD=UNAVAILABLE"; fi
items=$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ei 'astera|ast[e]?ria' | head -20 | tr '\n' ',' || :)
msg="$msg CONTAINERS=$items"
for n in $(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ei 'astera|ast[e]?ria' | head -7); do
 if docker exec "$n" sh -c 'test -f /app/src/llm/providers/openai-compatible.js || test -f /app/src/llm/llm-client.js' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
   msg="$msg $n=ADAPTER_PRESENT"
 else msg="$msg $n=ADAPTER_NOT_AT_STANDARD_PATH"; fi
done
gh api -X POST repos/seigo-gace/ai-core/issues/1/comments -f body="$msg" --jq '.html_url' >/dev/null
echo ASTERA_DISCOVERY=POSTED

chat_decision_checkpoint.source_evidence: AI Core Issue1 Current PR3 01ef, DebugAI separate. Second potential registered Astera v8 exists in Workspace Registry; Astera v8 main src/llm/providers/openai-compatible.js accepts configurable base URL/model and existing key; Source-only verified; need Host runtime discovery without product modifications.
